files.description: Threat model, trust boundaries, administrative authorities and the invariants SCC-SEC-001 to SCC-SEC-010. Each change must keep these invariants.
The @spec catalog for the verifier. Each SCC-* identifier has the same meaning as in SECURITY.md.
Architecture. Section 4 gives the design invariants: packet size, two-stage verification, freshness, PDA lifecycle and signed byte parsing.
Consumer contract: Mode A account checks, Mode B introspection, the V3 hash_action encoding, error codes and discriminators.
Sidecar specification: key handling, loopback API and attestation backends.
Known problems and conventions for persons and agents that change the code.
The sections that each pull request completes: change tier, threat model, new dependencies and the Critical-tier checklist.
